_about: The race view's cameras and dressing for Sandown Park. Written by tools/course/real/to_race_view.py; don't edit by hand. World axes as sandown.json.

ground.note: Ascot's lawn and turf colours (the bake's), so the two courses read as one game

lanesStraight.note: soft mown lanes along the straight, 3.75 m wide, as Ascot's

light._about: As Ascot's (courses/ascot-view.json -> light), with this course's sun raised. The model look (owner's AI concept stills, 9 Nov 2026), matching the bake (tools/blender/bake_static_world.py LOOK=model) and the Blender study (stand_clean_study.py variant model, model_look_post.py): a bigger, gentler sun higher in the sky, a strong lilac-blue sky fill, a sky cream-peach at the horizon, lilac, then soft cornflower; pale lilac haze; a little brighter; lavender in the shadows; the crowd in navy, camel, mustard, cream, rust and teal with grey morning dress. sky: horizon, low and upper colours (linear); sunDir: from the field to the sun (course axes); hemi: sky colour, ground colour, strength; grade: saturation, sepia, hue (degrees), brightness, contrast (as the storybook grade); lift: tinted shadows. clouds: "ring" puts soft clouds all round the sky. trees: "clay" uses the clay trees (rounded clustered crowns on trunks). ?light=before shows the light before.

races._about: The races the view can show, one for every start in sandown-stalls.json. course: 'straight' (no bend) or 'round' (down the leg and round the bend into the straight); distance in metres; start: the key in the stalls file.

track_straight.label: Tracking
track_straight.note: the car along the stand-side rail, up over the lawns and the festival (raise: x from, x to, height)

track_loop.label: Tracking
track_loop.note: the car down the leg and round the bend, on the stand side of the track (the outside of the bend at the Rowley Mile, the inside on the July Course)

drone_straight.label: Drone
drone_straight.note: ahead of the leaders, looking back at the whole field (Ascot's straight-course drone): over the stand side at the Rowley Mile; over the inside half of the track on the July Course, so its picture is the track and the far side, not the empty lawns up the straight behind the inside rail

headon.label: Head-on
headon.note: the long lens beyond the line, in the middle of the run-out, looking straight up the course: the field coming at it, the groups spread across the track

grandstand.label: Finish
grandstand.note: the finish square on from the infield, 30 m inside the line, the stands behind it (212-216 s); the stand camera's place in every rule (the hold on the line after the winner)

sideon.label: Side-on replay
sideon.note: square on to the winning line from the stand side: the finish again in slow motion

start.label: Start
start.note: low on the outer side in front of the stalls, looking back across their faces (Ascot's)

sprint_stand.label: Sprint finish
sprint_stand.note: on the sprint course's line, out on the festival side, low: the field against the boards and bushes on the far side (59-61 s)

sprint_headon.label: Head-on
sprint_headon.note: beyond the sprint course's post, the long lens down it

sprint_sideon.label: Side-on replay
sprint_sideon.note: square on to the sprint course's line from the festival side, the bushes behind

track_inside.label: Tracking (infield)
track_inside.note: the car in the infield just inside the inside rail, a long lens: the outer rail and what's beyond it behind the field (the video's 14-37 s, 62-110 s and 170-212 s)

bend_headon.label: West bend, head-on
bend_headon.note: on the outside of the west bend, the long lens back down the home straight as they come past the stands the first time (0-14 s, 37-46 s)

west_bend_high.label: West bend
west_bend_high.note: high inside the west bend, across the field as it turns (46-54 s)

back_headon.label: Back straight, head-on
back_headon.note: low inside the end of the back straight, behind the chase fences, the field coming at it (110-120 s)

far_bend_headon.label: Far bend
far_bend_headon.note: on the outside in the far bend, head-on as they come round it, the rail curving away on the left (120-150 s, 156-160 s)

far_bend_high.label: Far bend, high
far_bend_high.note: high on the inside at the end of the bend, across them (150-156 s)

finish_infield.label: Finish (infield)
finish_infield.note: stands for the infield finish camera, so the festival is cleared round it (clearAround)

track_sprint.label: Tracking
track_sprint.note: the car on the sprint course's near side, 10 m off its rail and up over the rail crowd, looking across at the far side's bushes (the video's 0-58 s)

raceDirector.schedule: On the Rowley Mile (owner, 10 Nov) path.tracking is set: the tracking car all the way down the course (on the leg and round the bend, then along the straight), then the stand camera from path.grandstand (down the Dip) to the line; no drone (from up there the picture showed what lies behind the Dyke) and no head-on. (path.drone3f and path.flicks, if set, cut to the drone from 3f out and for short flicks on the way.)
raceDirector._about: One path (owner, 8 Nov: tracking car, head-on, the stand camera, the drone). Round races: the tracking car down the leg and round the bend until path.drone metres into the straight; then the drone along the stand side; the head-on long lens from beyond the line for the stretch path.headon ([from, to] metres to go, only when the race is longer than path.headonMin); the stand camera from path.grandstand to the line and beyond. After the finish: the side-on replay, slowed to replaySpeed, from replayFrom metres before the line to replayTo after it.
raceDirector.shotsNote: Sandown (owner, 19 Nov 13:34, his Racing TV video of a 2m50y race): head-on down the home straight from the outside of the west bend as they come past the stands the first time; the infield car alongside, the stand side behind them; head-on again into the west bend; high across the bend from inside it; the tracking car up the west side; the infield car all along the back straight, the golf course in front of it, the houses beyond; head-on at the end of the back straight from behind the chase fences; head-on round the far bend; high across the end of the bend; the tracking car down the east side; the infield car up the run-in, the stand side behind; then the finish square on from the infield, the stands behind the line. The sprint course: the tracking car, its head-on, its own finish camera (cameraSwap). Sprint course (owner, 13:52, his Racing TV video of a 5f10y race): one camera alongside the whole way, on the near (festival) side looking across the field to the far rail, the bushes and the golf course beyond, the near rail's crowd in the foreground at the end; then the finish square on from the near side, the boards on the far rail at the line. [from, to, camera] by the leader's metres to go; outside every shot, the path's rules

setPieces._about: Before the off and after the race: eye and at go from the first to the second over 'seconds'.
